hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, J iid Normal(0,1), SeedSequence([20261115, N, k])

families.nodata: retained shared-gamma, interleaved packing, 1+3L, seed provider
families.K: retained shared-gamma, interleaved packing, 2+3L, seed provider
families.nodata_pack: same circuit as nodata on the |J|-max triple partition, seed provider for K_pack
families.K_pack: same circuit as K on that partition, seed provider for KM_pack
families.KM_pack: retained shared-gamma circuit with the triple partition that maximizes sum of |J| inside triples. Not a new gate. 3+3L
families.KM_gl: NEW family. Per-layer a_l on Hc, shared b and c on Khat and Mhat, interleaved packing, 2+4L. All a_l equal reproduces KM. Not reported as KM
families.qaoa: independent gamma_l and beta_l, 2L, round-3 standard budget

packing_rule: exact maximization of sum of |J_ij| over the three edges of each triple, partition of all sites, ties broken by lexicographically smallest sorted partition. Classical J only.
box: every linear coefficient, including each a_l of KM_gl and each QAOA gamma_l, in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J]; shells and beta in [-2pi, 2pi]. Same box as round 3.
continuation: KM and KM_pack: Zhou interp of shells with coefficients kept, time-rescaled coefficients times (L-1)/L, perturbations N(0,0.1) and N(0,0.3), two ramps, nested seed. KM_gl: Zhou interp of a_l and shells with b,c kept, append a zero layer (exact identity), same perturbations, two ramps with a per-layer ramp, nested from KM. QAOA: Zhou interp, append-zero, perturbations, two ramps, best append-zero plus N(0,0.05).
selection: lowest energy within a repeat; primary is the lower of the two repeats. No ground state, eigenvector, E0 or fidelity in packing, features, starts, beam or selection.
primary_metric: F_sub within 1e-6 of E0, all N, computed after selection

advancement.eligible_at_N_in_9_12: median(F_V - F_Q) >= median(F_KM - F_Q) + 0.02 AND mean(F_V) >= mean(F_KM) - 0.01 AND joint wins of V >= joint wins of KM AND wins of V >= wins of KM
advancement.hold_N6: median(F_V - F_Q) >= median(F_KM - F_Q) - 0.02 AND joint wins of V >= joint wins of KM
advancement.advance_if: eligible at N=9 or N=12, and hold_N6, on complete dev instances only
advancement.pick: among advancing variants, the larger sum over N of (median dF_V - median dF_KM); tie goes to KM_pack
advancement.if_none: no confirmation of these variants; the next round tests a different change

job_order: k ascending, within k N=12 then 9 then 6, repeats inner, so a wall drops the highest k at every N
replay: replay_independent.py rebuilds J, both packings, K and M, and the XX/XXX shells from their definitions with sparse Pauli strings, evolves with expm_multiply and takes the ground space from eigsh. It imports no runner.
replay_scope: every selected state of every repeat, all families
